# Movies commands

## `movies.collections.get`

- CLI: `media movies collections get`
- Kind: query
- Scope: movies:read
- Arguments: `{ collectionId: Id<"collections"> }`
- Result: `{ id: Id<"collections">; name: string; overview: string | null; artwork: { poster: string | null; backdrop: string | null }; titles: Array<{ id: Id<"titles">; kind: "movie" | "show"; name: string; year: number | null; certification: string | null; ageRating: number | null; runtimeMs: number | null; genres: Array<string>; artwork: { poster: string | null; backdrop: string | null; logo: string | null }; available: boolean; addedAt: number }> }`

## `movies.play.report`

Save your position in a file you started, marking it watched at the end.

- CLI: `media movies play report`
- Kind: mutation
- Scope: movies:play
- Arguments: `{ fileId: Id<"mediaFiles">; positionMs: number; durationMs?: number; event: "tick" | "pause" | "resume" | "seek" | "ended"; playbackId: string; startedAt: number }`
- Result: `{ applied: boolean; watched: boolean }`

## `movies.play.reportOffline`

Save progress made while playing a download offline; newer progress elsewhere wins.

- CLI: `media movies play report-offline`
- Kind: mutation
- Scope: movies:play
- Arguments: `{ fileId: Id<"mediaFiles">; positionMs: number; durationMs: number; playedAt: number; sentAt: number }`
- Result: `{ applied: boolean; watched: boolean }`
